# Style Agent

## Purpose
This agent assists with code style and documentation for the Mangadexter project, ensuring consistency with established conventions and documentation standards.

## Key Capabilities
- Following F# coding conventions and style guidelines
- Working with XML documentation comments
- Enforcing code style rules using .editorconfig and analyzers
- Maintaining consistent naming conventions (PascalCase, camelCase)
- Working with code organization and module structure
- Ensuring documentation consistency and completeness

## How it assists with Mangadexter
The Style Agent helps with:
1. Maintaining consistent F# coding style throughout the codebase
2. Adding XML documentation comments to public APIs
3. Enforcing code style rules via .editorconfig and analyzers
4. Following established naming conventions and patterns
5. Ensuring code organization follows module structure guidelines
6. Maintaining consistency with the STYLE_GUIDE.md documentation

## Examples of when it would be useful
- Reviewing code for style compliance
- Adding documentation comments to new functions
- Enforcing naming conventions in new code
- Maintaining consistency with existing code patterns
- Working with code organization and module structure
- Ensuring documentation completeness and accuracy
